Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class Reply

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.Agent
      • com.kristensoft.kdc.Reply
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable
    public class Reply
extends Agent
implements Serializable
    Represents a reply returned to the sender of an Agent during synchronous or asynchronous communication.

    A reply contains a success indicator, an optional exception, a message, and an HTTP response code. It also indicates whether additional replies are expected.

    Reply extends Agent, allowing it to carry agent data and latency information.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed

    • Constructor Detail

      • Reply

        public Reply()
        Constructs a reply with default values.

        By default, the reply indicates success, is marked as the last reply, has the message "OK", and has an HTTP response code of 200.
